text:
The source motivates the definition by a sharpening of its register-machine
reduction class, and lists two prefix classes of Krom and Horn formulas as
conservative reduction classes in Exercise~2.1.37
\cite[Sect.~2.1.2, pp.~36--37]{BorgerGradelGurevich1997}.  Both results are
proved in \cref{sec:p02-w02b-p02-031-register}: the refined logic-machine
formulas reduce satisfiability and finite satisfiability at the same time
(\cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-031-ex-2-1-34}), and the two classes are conservative
reduction classes (\cref{thm:p02-w02b-p02-031-ex-2-1-37}).
reason: Section 21.8 MP-0 (d), (e): the statement that Exercises 2.1.34 and 2.1.37 are not proved is superseded; the written proofs are annex:p02-w02b-p02-031-ex-2-1-34 and annex:p02-w02b-p02-031-ex-2-1-37 (with annex:p02-w02b-p02-031-two-register-simulation, -register-reduction, -logic-machine). The w02b-p02-031 inputs must follow the w02-p02-036 inputs in the drivers (already so in the packet's insertion proposal); the forward \cref from w02-p02-036 to the later section resolves in the same build.
